title: Afraid of going out at night in New York
summary: He avoids going out at night now.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: At the time I wasn't working, just a few weeks, it ain't like things is now -- I wouldn't be afraid to go out at night, you know. But now I'm afraid to go out at night. When I'm not working, I don't go out.
I see. It's kind of rough out there.

Especially... It's pretty fair going down sometimes, but I go down early, because I figure on getting back early, you know. But I'll go down there and get surrounded with musicians sort of talking, and have a little party(?) once in a while there, and I find out I'm there and the place is closing -- it's three o'clock in the morning! At 3:30 or four o'clock I'll get back. And that's the time they're going to get you.
That's when they're out looking for stragglers.
